380-    the state machine as the scheduler drives it. It records how many attempts
381-    have been made and a compact timeline of ``(virtual_time, state)`` entries
382-    so that history queries can reconstruct what happened without replaying the
383-    whole event log.
384-    """

404-        self.finish_at = None
405-        self.available_at = 0
406-        self.last_error = None
407-
408-    @property

412-        return self.task.id

416-        """The scheduling priority of the underlying task."""
417-
418-        return self.task.priority

421-        """Set ``state`` and append a timeline entry stamped at ``now``.
